Do you by chance know a workaround?

What I'm trying to do is let the user upload a dataset, let R plot it and then use identify to let the user click the plot and let R save to coordinates of these clicks in a txt. file or something similar.

For example:



print("Upload reference dataset")
sp<-read.table(choose.files("E:\\UMH_zoologie\\_morphometrie\\_Bombus\\NCB_naturalis\\*.txt*"), header=FALSE, sep="\t", na.strings="NA", dec=".", strip.white=TRUE)

sp.LIST <- read.table(choose.files("E:\\UMH_zoologie\\_morphometrie\\terrestribombus\\results\\*.txt*"), header=FALSE, sep="", na.strings="NA", dec=".", strip.white=TRUE)

plot(sp[,1],sp[,2])
identify(sp)
